title: Cross-tier memory spiral: KV index tear under high-concurrency inference causing GPU OOMs
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Several production customers across Hosted, Dedicated and Private deployments started seeing spikey GPU OOMs during high-concurrency inference windows. Root-cause analysis shows a race between the async evictor and the KV index rebuild path which leaves stale tombstones and orphaned handles in ephemeral slab arenas. The resulting fragmentation prevents contiguous tensor allocations and drives OOM cascades (observed on both Ampere and Hopper node types). This ticket tracks the emergency hotfix, durable runtime change, rollout and follow-up work.
impact: Multiple paying customers experienced request failures and elevated latency. Incidents observed in Hosted (region-us-west-2), Dedicated (rsv-42 pools) and Private (customer A on-prem). Customer-facing impact: failed requests, retries, and temporary request throttling by application owners. Severity: P0 / high customer_impact.
mitigation: Immediate mitigations applied: 1) Scoped tenant isolation (reduce concurrent inference threads for affected tenants), 2) Temporary increase in eviction aggressiveness for KV cache, 3) Emergency configuration to prefer smaller contiguous tensor pools on impacted node classes, 4) Roll rollback policy to fallback to older allocator behavior for critical customers.
proposed_fix: Deterministic index update barrier: serialize index mutation and evictor compaction for keys currently in rebuild window. Add 'compact-on-free' heuristic to reclaim contiguous arenas after tombstone accumulation. Introduce a lightweight background compactor that coalesces small free segments with adaptive throttle tied to GPU memory pressure. Add unit tests and a stress harness that reproduces high-concurrency evict/rebuild cycles.
rollout_plan: Phase 0: staged hotpatch to runtime branch and smoke on CI. Phase 1: Canary rollout to a single Hosted region and one Dedicated pool (low-traffic), monitor memory fragmentation and OOM rates for 24h. Phase 2: expand to additional clusters and selected Private customers with opt-in. Phase 3: full rollout with automated rollback on OOM regression. Rollout will be gated by metrics in console: per-node OOM rate, contiguous free arena ratio, KV tombstone growth.
test_plan: 1) Unit tests for index mutation barrier and compactor invariants. 2) Integration test with synthetic workload that alternates high-concurrency allocations and evictions to validate fragmentation bound. 3) Long-running chaos test (48h) in staging with randomized thread interleaving to catch races. 4) Benchmark to measure CPU and latency overhead of the new compactor.
postmortem_actions: Add evict/index mutation telemetry and alerts
Bake fragmentation checks into canary gating
Run heap-snapshot capture on OOM path and retain for 7 days
Document manual recovery steps for Private installs
